drive._doc: Shared by all trucks. Brakes are instant and shared (M pick 4). No hill hold or parking brake: coasting rolls back (M pick 3).

phys._doc: Per truck (L-MM-5). pull = force/mass is the gas acceleration; ground torque = torque/mass is the gas/brake pitch push while a wheel touches (engine torque is the v7i 0.8, crane 0.28, so heavier trucks pitch less; the roller gets 1.12 to keep its v7i pitch push). maxV and pull are the identity numbers (M pick 2); air, spin, coast, link, w and tol stay at v7i values. w = point weights [rear-bottom, front-bottom, front-top, rear-top, rear wheel, front wheel] (centre of mass only). snowRoof = extra roof weight at full snow. hull = sprite whose colliders and wheels the physics uses.

mixer.note: heavy drum at the back: strong pull (18), low-mid top speed; heavy, so it pitches less

digger.note: low and stable, slow and steady (pull 17.1)

dump.note: fast and light: the top speed, the weakest pull uphill (15)

crane.note: top-heavy, tips easily (snow roof load capped: roof weight max 1.96, was 2.52)

crash._doc: Crash time grows only while the truck touches something (ground, a mover or a prop): upside down or roof pushed from above at full rate, tipped at tippedRate. In the air it never grows (flips are a skill, M pick 1). Crash when crash time > phys[truck].tol. v7j respawn (RESPAWN-REPORT.md option A, same as the Unity sim): on a crash respawn (resetTruck(true)), respawnClearLift=1 raises the flat spawn just enough that every colliding point (wheels; body corners only without sprite geometry) sits respawnClear m above the ground under it; velocity stays 0. 0 = old spawn.

weather._doc: L-MM-17 Mild patch values (weather thread, 2026-11-02 04:40), plus phase 3a (p3w): vmax = top-speed multiplier per weather (the lever that sets the time cost); pull = gas drive-force multiplier and gripCurve = how much the gas grip limit falls toward top speed, both per weather and both left neutral (swept, they moved pass rates more than time); brakes and brake grip are untouched (M picks 4/5) and the coast hold keeps its rollback (M pick 3). zones = count and length of each weather zone; jumpClear = L-MM-16 clearance (m) from every jump ramp start to its landing foot for zones and hidden rocks. Phase 3c (p3s): propClear = the same clearance (m) for pushable props (cones, barrels, pipes, snow lumps; body span x±r) per weather; 0 keeps the old spots. Clear stays 0 so the clear sweep (and par) is unchanged.

props._doc: Light physics props (cones, barrels, pipes, snow lumps). The push a prop gives the truck is divided by phys[truck].mass.

par._doc: Classic par per truck and level (s), v7j phase 3b (L-MM-21), measured on the v7j-p3w build in each level's own weather (classic always plays LEVEL_WX; par is not scaled by weather). Rule: the fast-quartile pass time of 30 bot policies (pitch18 + speed12, run.t), rounded up to 0.5 s; 0.1 or 0.05 s only where tie clumps would put over half the passes under par. v7j final: L3 and L8 (snow) re-measured with the same rule on the final build after the phase 3c snow-prop fix (other cells unchanged; their sweep rows are identical). See p3p/P3P.md and TUNING-v7j.md. K = fallback formula factor for Load and Daily (unchanged).
